examples.title: Checkboxes and radios
examples.description: Options that stay open as you change them.

a11y: role="menu" with menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio items. The trigger says it opens a menu and whether it's open.
Enter, Space or Down Arrow opens it on the first item; Up Arrow opens it on the last.
Arrow keys move, Home and End jump, typing a letter goes to the next item that starts with it. Escape or Tab closes it and returns focus to the trigger.
Only one item is in the tab order at a time, so Tab leaves the menu instead of walking through it.
